about_short_description.short_description: Bekia is an app that people can use to monetize their daily waste.

product.name: Waste Collection and Recycling Service
product.description: Bekia offers a service where users can exchange their non-organic waste for goods or services. The process involves separating waste at home, estimating the quantity, and scheduling a pickup through the app.

product.name: Electronic Waste Recycling
product.description: This service focuses on the collection and recycling of electronic waste, allowing users to dispose of their electronic devices responsibly.

product.name: Cooking Oil Recycling
product.description: Bekia provides a service for collecting used cooking oil from households, preventing improper disposal that can harm the environment.

product.name: Paper Recycling
product.description: This service involves the collection of paper waste, including books, newspapers, and other paper products, for recycling.

product.name: Plastic Recycling
product.description: Bekia collects various types of plastic waste for recycling, aiming to reduce plastic pollution.

product.name: Metal Recycling
product.description: This service includes the collection and recycling of metal waste, such as aluminum cans and metal containers.
